name: Facet-First Query Planning / Progressive Query Hydration / Capability-Native Routing
principle: Preserve raw user intent; collapse the executable text query to the broadest useful umbrella term; transfer explicit constraints into native structured controls; execute the least-expensive deterministic stage first; hydrate only when a sufficiency gate fails.
hard_constraints: raw intent is retained for lineage and may not be silently rewritten
no facet or constraint may be invented merely to improve retrieval
when a native checkbox, dropdown, range, scope or selector can represent a constraint, use that control before adding query prose
do not hydrate full files or corpora when a bounded structured packet is sufficient for the selected tool
do not assign every model the same role or assume every LLM has the same capability
route work by declared and verified designed function before current convenience or historical purpose
formal solvers and simulators receive typed parameters, units, bounds, configuration IDs and source references rather than unbounded prose where possible

LLMs are preferred for language decomposition, taxonomy mapping, ambiguity resolution, pattern synthesis and representation; deterministic tools remain preferred for arithmetic, exact transforms and formal simulation when available
semantic or visual generation may represent resolved state but cannot invent missing canonical values
query normalisation cannot widen security, authority, evidence or mutation scope

model_variability_policy.rule: Model and agent roles are capability-advertised and task-bound. A small/local model may classify or apply known facets while a frontier model may resolve ambiguous semantics; neither inherits authority or competence merely because both are LLMs.
model_variability_policy.fallback: If a requested function is not declared or evidenced, route to another admitted capability or hold; do not guess.

progressive_hydration.stage_0: umbrella query + bound native facets + minimum source/object scope
rehydration_order: hydrate raw documents or broader corpus last
progressive_hydration.never: mass-hydrate by default merely because the model can consume more context

examples.raw_input: simulate the selected transfer with the current source-reconciled spacecraft and epoch
examples.packet_rule: resolve source/config IDs and pass typed GMAT state/epoch/force-model/maneuver/objective fields; do not feed the full project corpus into GMAT
